sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 160. Success value 100. 5x physical damage (Time).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 160. Success value 100. 5x magic damage (Time).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Applies 50% elevation for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases Unison gauge gains by 3 for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies excluding yourself. Fills Unison gauge by 30.
-Target: all allies. Recovers 50 Cost.
-Target: all allies. Increases Cost recovery speed by 10 for 90 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Barracks for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] increases all stats by 100%; [Special] increases critical hit chance by 100%; [Special] increases physical/magic attack Ability success value by 40; [Special] reduces cooldown time by 50%. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).

-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 260. Success value 100. 5x magic damage (Time).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Removes Scorching from all allies.
-Removes Frozen from all allies.
-Removes Slumber from all allies.
-Removes Rejection from all allies.
-Removes Insanity from all allies.
-Target: all allies. Applies Serenity for 60 seconds (increases max HP, DEF, and MDEF by 100%; nullifies debuffs and Cost reduction. After the effect ends, your character's Unison gauge is filled by 100).
-Target: yourself. Applies Armament for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; increases ATK and MATK by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction and Unison gauge reduction; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 20000
Increases your time elemental Unison damage Ability Power by 30.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 20000

[Dragon Symbiotics] Grun & Vi & Ho & Ki or Ninoyu with the same or higher Cost of the base Monster can be used as fodder.
 *Specific Monsters may also be used. See the Help section for details.
